items.title: The Stock Market Is Doing Something Observed Only 6 Times Since 1871 -- and the Previous 5 ...
items.summary: The stock market has crushed all other asset classes on an annualized return basis over the long term. Stocks have entered dubious valuation territory that's only been visited a half-dozen times over ...
